title: [P0][catalog,a11y] Catalog "Recategorize" select has no accessible name
goal: The Select in app/(app)/catalog/catalog-manager.tsx:87-97 only renders a <label> when a label prop is passed (components/ui/select.tsx:37-41); this instance passes placeholder='Recategorize...' but no label and no aria-label. Screen-reader users get an unlabeled combobox on the primary recategorize control -- a WCAG 4.1.2 violation.
in_scope: Add aria-label='Recategorize item' (or a visible <label>, whichever fits the existing catalog-manager.tsx layout better) to the Recategorize Select.

Spot-check catalog-manager.tsx's other controls (bulk-select checkboxes, merge trigger) for the same missing-label pattern while in this file, since this is exactly the kind of gap that repeats across similar controls.
out_of_scope: A full accessibility audit of the entire Catalog page beyond this specific control and its immediate neighbors -- broader a11y sweep is not this story's scope.
Any visual restyling of the Select component -- REQ-29/E-23 scope.
acceptance: The Recategorize Select carries an aria-label or visible label announced by screen readers. Verified via an accessibility check (axe or equivalent) that the control now has an accessible name.
invariants: The fix must not change the Select's visual appearance or existing placeholder behavior -- this is an accessibility-attribute-only fix.
